mapper.sql: id, account, nickname, password, status, is_builtin, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE account = #{account} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE account = #{account} AND deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE u.account = #{account} AND u.deleted = 0 AND m.perms != ''
SELECT id, account, nickname FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT id, account, nickname FROM sys_user WHERE status = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (account, nickname, password, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{account}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:

nickname = #{nickname},
status = #{status},
update_by = #{updateBy},
update_time = #{updateTime},
